after.zh: 亮点、投票、找峰：Hough 把「找一条线」变成「在累加器里找峰」，挡掉了零散的杂点，线断了几段也照样找得到。车道保持系统的第一代就是这么做的。
after.en: Points, votes, peaks: Hough turns "find a line" into "find a peak in the accumulator", which ignores scattered specks and still finds a line broken into pieces. The first lane-keeping systems worked exactly like this.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="hough"></part-ref>：亮点进去，出来一张 (θ, ρ) 的票数图。
t.en: The <part-ref to="hough"></part-ref> in the tray: bright points go in, and a map of votes over (θ, ρ) comes out.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：路面上有两条车道线和几个亮点，在累加器里只标出这两条线。
t.en: Your task in this level: the road has two lane lines and a few bright specks; mark only these two lines in the accumulator.

brief.zh: 路面上有两条亮的车道线和几个亮点。在 Hough 累加器里只标出这两条线的格子：票数乘 1/8 以后的峰。
brief.en: The road has two bright lane lines and a few bright specks. Mark only the cells of these two lines in the Hough accumulator: the peaks after multiplying the votes by 1/8.

hint.zh: 每个亮点都投票，可一个孤零零的亮点票数分散，成不了峰。
hint.en: Every bright point votes, but a lone speck spreads its votes thin and makes no peak.
